$description: Temps operator design tokens (W3C DTCG). Two layers: `base` is the raw material (the paper/ink pair, the five state hues, faces, radius, border, the spacing scale, the type scale, motion); `semantic` is what a component may name, and is exactly the set of CSS custom properties the shipped skin declares — `.operator.ink` for light, `.dark .operator.ink` for dark. Colour values are CSS `oklch()` / `color-mix()` strings rather than DTCG colour objects, because the stylesheet is the truth and the two must match byte for byte; `scripts/tokens.mjs check` enforces that and runs in `bun run lint`. Aliases (`{base.x.y}`) resolve to those same strings. Editing a value here does NOT change the CSS yet: `scripts/tokens.mjs build` prints the block that would be generated, and generation is the next step.

base.$description: Raw material. Never referenced by a component; only by `semantic`.

paper.$description: Warm off-white. The page in light.

paper-raised.$description: One step lighter than paper: popovers and inset panes in light.

paper-sunk.$description: One step darker than paper: muted bands, secondary fills, hover.

paper-shade.$description: Two steps darker: the accent surface (a pressed/selected row).

ink.$description: Near-black. Text, and every border in light.

grey.$description: Secondary text on paper. 6.9:1, passes AA at body size.

grey-chart.$description: The second chart series in light. Never text.

night.$description: Warm near-black. The page in dark.

night-inset.$description: Inset panes in dark: logs and code sit below the page.

bone.$description: Warm off-white ink. Text, and every border in dark.

grey-chart-bright.$description: The second chart series in dark.

state-destructive.$description: Failing, unreachable, irreversible. 5.5:1 on paper. Darker than the shadcn default, which fails AA.

state-warning.$description: Degraded, above threshold, expiring. ≥4.5:1 on paper.

focus.$description: The focus ring, and the only blue in the system. Never a surface, never text, never a chart.

rule-soft.$description: 16% ink. Row dividers inside a frame only — the frame itself is full ink. Never text.

sans.$description: Geist. Every word that is not data.

mono.$description: Geist Mono. Ids, numbers, logs, keys. Tabular by default.

control.$description: The only radius. Frozen (handoff §4). Selects square off to 0 in v1.

hairline.$description: The only border width. Every border is ink.

space.$description: The 4px grid, capped at 32. Anything outside this list is a mistake, not a decision.

4.$description: Glyph to word, icon to label.

8.$description: Inside a row; between a control and its key badge.

12.$description: Row padding at comfortable density; between a title and its body.

20.$description: Section rule gap: `.op-block + .op-block` above and below.

24.$description: Between a section and the next group.

32.$description: The largest gap inside a console page. Landing sections use `.op-section` padding instead.

label.$description: `.op-label`. Eyebrow, column header, key badge. Never a section title.

font-weight.$description: Weight is the signal: the tier is readable without measuring the size.

semibold.$description: `.op-h2`, `.op-h3`. A section title is never lighter.

fast.$description: A control acknowledging the pointer: an inline action icon coming out of muted, a hover tint. Below 80ms the change reads as a flicker.

base.$description: The default, and a frozen decision (handoff §4 'Motion is 100ms'). Every state change of a control: fill, border, transform, shadow.

slow.$description: The ceiling, and only for something arriving on top of the page: a dialog, a drop. Nothing in the page body may take this long.

standard.$description: Fast out, settled end. One curve for everything; a second curve is a second opinion about the same 100ms.

raise-offset.$description: The hard offset of `.op-raise`. No blur, no spread, ink — a printed offset, not a glow. The one raised thing per screen.

semantic.$description: What a component may name. These are the CSS custom properties of the shipped skin, in declaration order. `light` and `dark` are asymmetric on purpose: dark only redeclares what changes, everything else cascades from light.

sh.temps.op.$comment: First selector that exists in op.css wins, so a rename of the skin class needs one edit here.

foreground.$description: Text, and every border: `--border` equals this.

destructive.$description: Failing, unreachable, irreversible loss. Never a hover, never a decoration.

success.$description: Healthy, passing, deployed. Always with a glyph and a word.

card.$description: Equal to the page: there are no cards. Kept so shadcn primitives do not fall back to white.

primary.$description: Filled controls. Ink by default; `data-accent` swaps only this and its foreground, landing only.

secondary.$description: A quiet fill: a secondary button, a badge.

muted.$description: Section tone, row hover, the sampled band on a chart.

muted-foreground.$description: Secondary text, units, idle glyphs, kind icons. The only grey.

accent.$description: The surface of a selected or focused row.

border.$description: Every border is ink. Row dividers inside a frame use `op-rule-soft` instead.

ring.$description: The focus ring, and nothing else.

chart-1.$description: The measured series. Ink on paper, a line, no fill.

chart-2.$description: The baseline series. A chart never has a third neutral: series 3–5 are status colours.

op-inset.$description: Log panes, code blocks, previews — a surface the page sits above.

op-rule-soft.$description: Row dividers inside a frame. The one deliberately faint value; never text.

op-raise-shadow.$description: `.op-raise`: a hard 3px ink offset, no blur. The one raised element per screen. Static — see docs/motion.md, exception 1.

font-sans.$description: Every word that is not data.

op-duration-fast.$description: `.op-motion-fast`. Hover acknowledgement on an inline action icon.

op-duration.$description: The blanket transition duration for the whole skin, and `.op-motion`.

op-duration-slow.$description: `.op-motion-slow`, and the dialog/alert-dialog entrance. Nothing in the page body.

op-ease.$description: The one curve. Serialised as CSS because it is consumed as a custom property; `{base.easing.standard}` is the same numbers.

sh.temps.op.$comment: Dark redeclares only what changes; radius, faces, ring and motion cascade from light.

destructive.$description: Lighter and less saturated so it clears 4.5:1 on night.

destructive-foreground.$description: Ink text on the lighter red fill; white would be 2.7:1. Light has no equivalent because white already passes there.

card.$description: Equal to the page: there are no cards.

primary.$description: Filled controls invert with the pair.

muted.$description: Section tone, row hover, sampled band.

muted-foreground.$description: Secondary text, units, idle glyphs, kind icons.

accent.$description: The surface of a selected or focused row.

border.$description: Every border is ink; in dark, ink is bone.

op-inset.$description: Log panes sit below the page. `.v1` takes this to true black.
